processSubtitle: From your first message to a file that is ready to submit. Six steps, in this order.

steps.title: Request a slot
steps.body: You send one message naming the offer you are interested in. No documents at this stage.

steps.title: Short qualification
steps.body: We ask three things: your destination, your target intake, and which documents you already hold.

steps.title: The call
steps.body: A scheduled video call. Your file is open on screen and we work through it together.

steps.title: Your written plan
steps.body: You receive a written plan: what to prepare, in which order, and by which date.

steps.title: The work
steps.body: CVs, motivation letters, translations and portal steps, handled at the level your tier covers.

steps.title: Review before submission
steps.body: Nothing goes out before a final read-through against the programme’s own stated requirements.

coachingBody: A private session is a scheduled video call with a named adviser. Your file is open on screen, the agenda is set before you join, and your questions are answered in Darja, French or English.
coachingEmphasis: It is a working session, not a sales call.
coachingNote: Bring your questions. Documents are exchanged through the channel agreed during the call — never over WhatsApp.
agendaItems: Gaps to close, and by which date
sessionNote: Everything decided here lands in your written plan.

guidesSubtitle: Both are real work. They answer different questions.

requestNote: A booking request, not a purchase.
promiseEyebrow: READ THIS BEFORE YOU PAY ANYONE
promiseIntro: No one can guarantee you a visa or an admission. Anyone who tells you otherwise is lying to you.

promises.title: The decision is never ours
promises.body: Admissions belong to universities. Visas belong to consulates and public authorities. Both decide on their own criteria and neither is obliged to explain.

promises.title: We are independent
promises.body: A-Step is an independent private service provider. We are not an embassy, a university, a consulate, a government body or an accredited agency, and we are not affiliated with any of them.

promises.title: No insider route
promises.body: There is no file we can move to the top of a queue and no contact who can make an exception for you. What we sell is a dossier prepared properly and on time.

promiseNote: What we are responsible for is the quality and the timing of the work we do on your file: complete documents, correct formats, letters written for the programme in question, and submission before the deadline. That is the whole of it, and it is written into our Terms.
refundSubtitle: The full position is in the Terms. This is the short version.

refunds.title: Free reschedule
refunds.body: For a scheduled consultation where substantive work has not been delivered, give at least 24 hours’ notice to choose one free reschedule, subject to availability. Send your name, service and appointment date/time through our official email or WhatsApp.

refunds.title: Full refund
refunds.body: If you cancel at least 24 hours before a consultation and substantive service has not been delivered, you may choose a 100% refund of its professional fee. Approved refunds are processed within ten business days after the decision, unless a different mandatory period applies.

refunds.title: Inside 24 hours, or no-show
refunds.body: Cancellation less than 24 hours before a consultation, or a no-show without notice, gives a 50% refund of the consultation professional fee under Terms V4.0. Documented exceptional circumstances may qualify for one reschedule or a full refund; a no-show exception request must be sent within seven calendar days.

refunds.title: Multi-session packages
refunds.body: When substantive work has begun, any refund reflects the unperformed portion of the professional service, taking account of work delivered, agreed milestones and lawful non-recoverable costs. Third-party charges are excluded unless A-Step received them and is responsible for refunding them.

refunds.title: Right of withdrawal
refunds.body: Ask us for the withdrawal conditions that apply to your booking before confirming it or requesting work to begin. Any mandatory consumer rights remain applicable; the consultation cancellation policy does not replace them.

termsNote: Reschedules, refunds, scope and liability are set out in full in the Terms of Service. If anything here and the Terms disagree, the Terms apply.
minorNote: Under nineteen? You are welcome to all the free resources and to an informational call. Any paid engagement involves a parent or guardian, who signs with you.

faqs.a: No. A-Step is an independent private service provider offering administrative guidance and tools for international applications. We are not a government agency, an embassy-certified firm or a diplomatic entity.

Any paid service, its scope and its price are explained before you agree. We accept the payment channels confirmed directly by A-Step, including Baridimob, CCP and bank transfer. An invoice is provided; third-party charges are excluded unless your order says otherwise. No payment is taken on this page.

faqs.q: What if I’m still in lycée?
faqs.a: You can explore our free guides and ask for an informational call. If you are under nineteen, a parent or guardian takes part in any paid engagement and signs with you.

faqs.q: Do you work with my destination?
faqs.a: Tell us your destination, programme and target intake when you contact us. We will confirm whether your application falls within the support we offer before you book.
You receive a written plan setting out your next steps, what to prepare and the relevant dates. Any further work follows the scope of the package you chose.

faqs.q: Can my parents speak to you directly?
faqs.a: Yes. Mention this when requesting your slot so we can arrange the conversation together. A parent or guardian is involved in paid engagements for clients under nineteen.

faqs.q: Do I send my documents on WhatsApp?
faqs.a: No. Use WhatsApp to ask questions and arrange your session. Documents are exchanged through the channel agreed during the call.
